content: Terbinafine tablets, USP, contain the synthetic allylamine antifungal compound known as terbinafine hydrochloride USP. Chemically, terbinafine hydrochloride is identified as (E)-N-(6,6-dimethyl-2-hepten-4-ynyl)-N-methyl-1-naphthalenemethanamine hydrochloride. The compound is presented as a white to off-white fine crystalline powder. Terbinafine hydrochloride is freely soluble in methanol and methylene chloride, soluble in ethanol, and only slightly soluble in water. Each tablet contains the active ingredient terbinafine hydrochloride USP, which is equivalent to 250 mg of terbinafine. The inactive ingredients in the formulation include microcrystalline cellulose, sodium starch glycolate, colloidal silicon dioxide, hypromellose, and magnesium stearate.
